definitions.gloss: monopolizing, hogging, keeping all to oneself
definitions.explanation: Taking or keeping something entirely for oneself without sharing with others.

examples.japanese: ⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧だ。
examples.english: What a luxury to have this view all to myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦リモコン→リモコン：05284_rimokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: She always hogs the remote and only watches her favorite shows.

notes:
USAGE: Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb ({独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The tone depends on context — it can be playful/lighthearted (hogging snacks) or negative (being selfish), or even positive (enjoying a beautiful place alone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to monopolize, to hog
- {独|ひと}り{占|じ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep all to oneself
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{独|ひと}り{占|じ}め: having a view all to oneself

Also written as ひとり{占|じ}め or {一人占|ひとりじ}め.
